SCOPE.theme: Baseline tissue and cell-type distribution of WWOX protein in normal human tissue
SCOPE.single_owner: This PMID has exactly one owner, this actor. It appears in no other open contract.
SCOPE.excluded: The four scientific current files and disease_model.md are NOT touched. D4, the DisMech anchor fragility and any infrastructural work are outside this task.

SCIENTIFIC_QUESTION: In which tissues and in which cell types is WWOX protein actually detected in normal human tissue, by what method, with what controls, and what does the study explicitly NOT establish? The question the corpus needs answered is the compartment one: which cell types carry the protein and which do not, at what level of evidence, and how the antibody and the scoring were validated.
WHY_THIS_PAPER: It is a named reading debt of priority ALTA in the full-text queue as FT-079, opened by this actor's own multi-hop of PMID 18674750 on 2026-09-09: that paper's Figure S3 showed a WWOX product in all nine human tissues including brain while its running text named only four, and this 2006 study is the protein-level counterpart of that endpoint RT-PCR gel. The debt and its provenance stay with the actor that can say what that gel did and did not show.

BLIND_PASS_FIREWALL.rule: scientist_reading_modes.md § 3.1 and § 3.3. The blind first pass receives the sources, the method and the technical packet — nothing else about the paper.

the DL-MECH-012 discovery-ledger tag and any convergence or inflammation-axis argument

BLIND_PASS_FIREWALL.note_on_your_own_prior_work: You may use the technical fact that FT-079 exists and what surface it names. You may NOT carry the interpretation your earlier reading placed on that gel into this paper's blind pass; this paper is read on its own evidence, and the comparison with the earlier reading happens in M4b.

16941225.identity: J Mol Histol 2006;37(3-4):115-25, Nunez MI, Ludes-Meyers J, Aldaz CM — three authors, Aldaz last.
16941225.structured_surface: None by the routes tested today: Europe PMC fullTextXML returns 404, and NCBI efetch db=pmc returns a 197-byte stub carrying the publisher's refusal to allow XML download. It is the pdf_only class the queue already recorded in FT-057.
16941225.what_that_does_and_does_not_mean: 🔴 It does NOT mean the paper is unavailable. A PMCID exists, which is what PubMed's free-full-text flag reflects, and the PMC web surface is the route that worked for other papers of exactly this class — PMID 30290271 and PMID 24871327 both reached complete_fulltext_read from it. Use the relevant alternatives and verify the identity and content of whatever you retrieve.
16941225.supplement: None declared in the metadata. Confirm from the article's own supplementary listing at acquisition rather than from that absence.
16941225.measured_gotchas: PMC serves a reCAPTCHA to a browser-like User-Agent and nothing to no User-Agent on some routes. If the only surface is a PDF whose text layer screens as SUSPECT, do not hand-correct it: anchor the affected locators to the rendered page via page_adjudications, or declare the debt.
16941225.figures: An immunohistochemistry study over tissue microarrays: the figures ARE the evidence. Inspect every available panel as an image at native resolution — a caption is not a panel, and captions_only downgrades the receipt. Note that the native surface may be a vector figure inside the publisher PDF rather than a PMC raster; check before rendering, and measure before calling a value unresolvable.

MILESTONE_PLAN: M0 duplicate-work gate — paper_packet.py packet and procedures, before opening anything. The packet reports no manifest and no receipt: this is a first_read

M1 acquisition — structured surface first where one exists; record the absence of one when it does not, with the cascade actually run, into the shared checkout's gitignored files/ with SHA-256 per artefact and the route recorded
M2 reading — section by section, surface inventory before the figures, every available panel at native resolution, locators captured while the document is open
M3 manifest — schema v2, strict validator PASS with zero gaps, plus paper_packet.py check
M4 receipt — through fulltext_receipts.py record, then verify
M4b comparison — a SEPARATE phase after the receipt lands, against whole records from registry_records.py, with comparison_check.py facts and check run before the note is written
M5 dossier, commit candidate where a registry record or claim is touched, discovery-ledger append where a lead emerges, and the FT-079 queue entry updated to say what was and was not closed
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: deepdive_manifest.py --pmid 16941225 --verify-artifacts --require-current-schema exits PASS with 0 gaps against the shared root checkout.
fulltext_receipts.py record succeeded and verify is OK afterwards; coverage values honest, with captions_only or unavailable used where true.

A dossier stating what the reading establishes, what it does NOT support, the figure audit table, the method limits — antibody specificity, scoring, absence of quantification where that is the case — and the transfer verdict toward the reference genotype.
The abstract is never the evidentiary surface for any locator.
An M4b note with the three-level comparison check run, and its coverage block read before its verdict.
legend_lint.py . stays PASS after every commit.
DELIVERABLES: an M4b comparison note, and a commit candidate where warranted
WAVE_1_RESULT in this file, carrying DEFAULTS_TAKEN and STOP_LOG even when empty (Annex A.1b)

COMMITTING.how: bash scripts/legend_commit.sh "<message>" <path> [<path> ...] — never git commit directly.
COMMITTING.never: No push. No write into another actor's files. A red caused by a peer's file is reported, not fixed.
COMMITTING.derived_surfaces: Do NOT regenerate shared derived surfaces; the orchestrator does that at wave close.

REVIEW_REQUIREMENT: Ladder floor R2. R4 / legend-locator-audit is REQUIRED before any reading is allowed to narrow, reverse, corroborate or remove a consolidated baseline claim, or to justify a MAJOR working-model bump, and on any contradicted persisted locator.

RETRY_POLICY.on_exhaust: PARK that surface with the written cascade and each literal response, and continue with what remains readable. An inaccessible surface is an explicit limit on completeness, never a reason to simulate a reading.

STOP_POLICY_REMINDER: §21c governs. Reserved and never yours: any push, history rewrite, deletion of unique material, external spend of any kind, modification of the four current files or disease_model.md, BATCH_COMMIT. Everything else has a safe default: take it, record it in DEFAULTS_TAKEN, continue. Running out of context is the one honest reason to stop, said in one line as that reason.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Dispatch recorded efetch db=pmc as a 197-byte stub; it returned 7,406 bytes of front matter plus the publisher's no-XML comment.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Recorded the measurement, kept the dispatch's conclusion (no structured surface) which was correct.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The refusal is real either way; only the size was wrong, and the artefact is fingerprinted.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Nothing scientific. Had I trusted the number over the response I would have carried a false measurement.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: PMC web article HTML and every /bin/ raster name form are behind reCAPTCHA, and pmc_pow_fetch.py refuses non-binary responses, so the deposit's own figure/supplement listing was unreachable.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Used the PDF's native embedded JPEGs as the figure surface (pdfimages confirms one image object per figure page and PyMuPDF finds no vector figure art) and declared the unreached listing explicitly.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The embedded JPEG IS the native raster here; nothing crisper exists. The one surface that could falsify supplement=not_present is named in the receipt and the dossier.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: If that listing ever shows a supplement, the coverage value is wrong and the read becomes partial. Recorded so a later session can check it.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Supplement status: metadata declared none; Europe PMC hasSuppl N; efetch front matter zero supplementary-material; manuscript read end to end contains no supplementary section or reference; PMC HTML listing unreachable.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Coverage supplementary=not_present on those three concordant grounds, with the gap named.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Three independent surfaces agree and the exception is declared rather than hidden.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: unavailable would have claimed a surface exists that I could not open; not_read would have refused the complete receipt on a supplement that appears not to exist.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Both IHC captions print 'All images 400 tm', which matches the printable-substitution defect class this repository has been bitten by.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Rendered the caption line at 600 dpi and verified the page prints '400 tm'; left the text layer untouched and recorded it as the authors' typesetting error.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The drawn glyph is the author's. Hand-correcting would have produced a surface no author wrote.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: A 'repair' would have manufactured a false surface and a false finding about extraction.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: No CNS panel exists, so the paper's most model-relevant claims have no image behind them.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Kept figures=read (every declared panel WAS inspected) and carried the absence as a panel-inventory locator plus an explicit evidence-class downgrade on every CNS statement.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: captions_only would have been false — the panels were inspected; the honest limit is that the panels do not cover the CNS, which is a content finding, not a coverage value.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Recording captions_only would have downgraded the receipt for a reason that is not true.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The blind locator audit softened one proposition and corrected another in a manifest already committed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Re-inspected the surfaces at native resolution BEFORE drafting, then revised the three entries with declared contradicts_locator objects carrying the audit, and re-ran the undeclared-revision guard.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The order is the control, and the guard exits 0 over the result; the wrong version stays visible in git history.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: An in-place rewrite with no declaration is the one shape no file-level gate sees.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: My own dossier carried locator pointers typed from memory, off by one from entry 21 onward, already committed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Re-derived the index map from the manifest, corrected the pointers, and added a dated correction note naming the wrong version's commit.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Append-style disclosure; no proposition, quote or verdict changed.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: A silent fix would have hidden a defect class this repository tracks deliberately.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: paper_packet check reports flag drift INSUFFICIENT_DATA because a first read has no prior manifest revision to diff.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Reported it as 'established nothing, not a pass' everywhere it is quoted, and did not work around it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: It is an honest nothing-to-screen, not a failure; misreporting it either way would be the defect.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Calling it green would have claimed a screen that never ran.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: A pointer-checking guard over dossier prose would have caught my off-by-one mechanically, but the dispatch forbids starting tooling projects.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Did not build it. Recorded the practice change (derive the index map from the artefact before writing any pointer prose) and named the tool as a proposal for Harness Engineering in the diagnosis.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: No harness change lands from a reading session; the defect is recorded where a harness owner will find it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Building it would have spent the reading's budget on infrastructure the dispatch reserved.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The FT-079 queue entry, which the dispatch permitted for technical facts, also carries an interpretive expectation about hormonal tissues.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Disclosed it at ACK, treated it as a hypothesis to be tested against the panels, and required every ranking statement to rest on this paper's own surfaces.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: The exposure is on the record before the reading, and the test is reported in the dossier and the M4b note.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_differ: Undisclosed, it would have read as an independent confirmation of another paper's Discussion.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: R4/locator audit was not required by this candidate's edits.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: Shared derived surfaces (batch_queue, coverage_report, reading_state, pathograph) are stale with respect to this reading.
